title: Random valuations
summary: A valuation is a finitely additive function on the family of compact convex sets in $\mathbb{R}^d$. We study non-negative infinitely divisible random valuations, with particular emphasis on monotone, $σ$-continuous models with independent increments along nested families. After separating the deterministic part, we show that the Lévy measure of such a valuation is generated by pairs $(F,r)$, where $F$ is a non-empty closed convex set and $r>0$, with each pair contributing $r\mathbf{1}_{F\cap K=\emptyset}$.
